# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull‑Request Template
# --------------------------------------------------------------

## Description
<!-- What does this PR do? Summarize the change in a few sentences. -->

## Type of change
<!-- Choose the appropriate option(s) -->
- [ ] **feat** – new feature
- [ ] **fix** – bug fix
- [ ] **chore** – maintenance / refactor
- [ ] **docs** – documentation only
- [ ] **test** – adding or fixing tests

## Checklist
- [ ] Version bump in `pubspec.yaml` (or `version.json`)
- [ ] All tests pass (`flutter test` / `npm test`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`flutter analyze` / `npm run lint`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)

## Release notes (optional)
<!-- Add a short note that will appear verbatim in the GitHub release.
     If left empty the auto‑generated notes will use the PR title. -->

## Breaking changes
<!-- Does this introduce breaking changes? 
     - [ ] Yes (describe migration steps below)
     - [ ] No -->
